notes: North is up. Printed names: ELMORE, BORDEN, MILLER, WEBER, AGNES, FOLLETT, DREMAN (no suffixes), FOLLETT ALLEY, DAWSON AV., ROLL AV. Suffixes taken from neighbouring sheets / key map: Weber St. and Agnes St. (sheet 609), Miller Av. (key map, north of Elmore), Follett Av. (sheet 608); Borden, Elmore and Dreman recorded as Street as on sheets 607/609. Follett is in two pieces that do not line up at Dreman: the diagonal 50 ft street from the oil works SSE to Dreman ('Follett Avenue (north of Dreman)') and FOLLETT AV. of sheet 608 running south from Dreman ~360 px further east ('Follett Avenue'). Follett Alley (12 ft) runs straight from Elmore SSE (dx/dy ~0.51) to Dreman. Miller runs south from Elmore between the block and the C.H.&D. right of way and meets Weber at the tracks. Weber jogs ~22 ft north about 1200 px east of Borden (two bends). Agnes dead-ends at a lot line. The C.H.&D. R.R. (ignored) crosses the sheet NNE-SSW. Elmore's drawn portion stops at x~4740 at the sheet-611 boundary (circled grade 55' at x~4710 marks a junction just beyond, not drawn here); no end recorded. The water pipes run ~15-25 px south/east of the street centres on Borden, Weber and Dreman; points are from the block faces.
